# Learn.Nectra Documentation & Developer Tutorials

> Learn.Nectra is a reference-grade developer education platform offering modern, interactive, and beginner-to-master tutorials for PHP, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL. Every lesson includes runnable sandbox code examples, syntax breakdown tables, and real-world analogies.

## Official Documentation Tracks

- [PHP Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/php-tutorials): Comprehensive reference guide for PHP. Learn server-side programming, syntax, forms, OOP, MySQL databases, and modern APIs with executable examples. [Keywords: php, php 8, php tutorial, learn php, modern php, php backend development, php mysql, pdo, php functions, object oriented php, web development]
- [Python Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/python-complete-tutorials): Master Python programming from scratch. Covers variables, data structures, OOP, modules, exception handling, and file operations with live code samples. [Keywords: python, python 3, python programming, learn python, python data structures, python oop, python tutorial, python automation, python backend, data engineering]
- [JavaScript Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/javascript-tutorial): Learn modern JavaScript (ES6+) for interactive web applications. Covers variables, functions, DOM manipulation, events, promises, and async/await. [Keywords: javascript, js tutorial, modern javascript, learn javascript, es6+, asynchronous javascript, dom manipulation, web development, frontend engineering, javascript masterclass]
- [HTML5 Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/html-tutorial): The standard markup language for building web pages. Master semantic elements, forms, audio/video, tables, and modern HTML5 layout architecture. [Keywords: html, html5, learn html, web development, semantic html, html tutorial, web design, frontend basics, responsive html, web accessibility]
- [CSS3 Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/css-tutorial): Style and design responsive websites. Master selectors, box model, Flexbox, CSS Grid, animations, and modern media queries. [Keywords: css, css3, learn css, responsive web design, flexbox, css grid, modern css, web styling, css animations, css tutorial, tailwind css]
- [SQL Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/sql-tutorial): The standard language for relational databases. Master SELECT queries, WHERE filters, JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, and database schemas. [Keywords: sql, relational database, mysql, sql queries, learn sql, database management, sql join, database indexing, backend database, data analytics]
- [React.js Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/react-tutorial): Master modern React (React 18 & 19) from the ground up. Learn JSX, components, props, hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef, useContext, useReducer), custom hooks, routing, concurrent features, and performance optimization with live runnable code examples. [Keywords: react, react js, react tutorial, learn react, modern react, react hooks, virtual dom, next js, react state management, frontend development, jsx, fiber architecture]
- [AngularJS Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/angular-tutorial): Master AngularJS (1.8) from absolute zero to enterprise production standard. Comprehensive 47-lesson curriculum covering MVC architecture, two-way data binding, custom directives, isolated scopes, dependency injection, REST APIs with $http, UI-Router, component architecture, testing with Jasmine, and migration to modern Angular. [Keywords: angularjs, angular, angularjs tutorial, learn angularjs, angular directives, angular controllers, dependency injection, angular services, ui-router, ng-model, two way data binding, angular filters, isolated scope, compile vs link, transclusion, karma jasmine, ngupgrade, single page application]
- [Next.js Tutorial](http://learn.nectradigital.com/course/nextjs-tutorial): Master Next.js 14 and 15 from absolute beginner to enterprise full-stack architect. Complete curriculum covering App Router, React Server Components (RSC), Server Actions, Streaming SSR with Suspense, Route Handlers, Caching & Revalidation, Middleware, Auth & Security, and an end-to-end full-stack project with live interactive demo. [Keywords: nextjs, next.js, nextjs tutorial, learn nextjs, app router, react server components, rsc, server actions, nextjs 14, nextjs 15, route handlers, dynamic routes, streaming ssr, suspense, nextjs caching, middleware, nextauth, full stack nextjs, vercel, nextjs project]
